Companion Animal Travel Desk Service Standard

This section sets the everyday standard for handling pet travel requests with care, consistency, and clear judgment. The desk should welcome each enquiry in a calm, professional tone and confirm the welfare needs of the animal before any booking is finalized. Staff must review carrier condition, ventilation, feeding arrangements, and the passenger's stated handling plan, then note any concern for the welfare coordinator to assess. When a pet travels, the cabin team must be briefed so that monitoring remains attentive and practical throughout the flight.

Travel acceptance depends on full compliance with the animal rules that apply to the booking. <<FACT F064>> Staff should record the outcome clearly and avoid promising acceptance before the review is complete. When a passenger presents a rabbit travel request, the desk must ensure the carriage plan matches the approved limit and that the crate is suitable, secure, and clean. The same care applies when a passenger raises a large dog request. <<FACT F075>> If the animal does not meet the standard, staff should explain the issue in plain language and offer the next suitable step without criticism.

The desk should also respond promptly when a passenger is worried, because reassurance helps maintain trust and reduces avoidable stress. Supervisors must be informed when a case appears unusual, when documentation is unclear, or when the passenger needs help understanding the result. Any correction to a file should be entered without delay so that the record remains accurate and easy to audit. Courtesy, consistency, and animal welfare remain the key measures of good practice at Aurelia Skyways.

For questions or escalation, contact the senior supervisor through the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
